# Atlas 0.3 classical Chinese typography / 中文古典字形

Atlas uses a web subset of **Zhuque Fangsong v0.212** for Chinese display text and **LXGW WenKai GB v1.522** for Chinese reading text. The subsets include every CJK character present in the Atlas 0.3 source, documentation and ChefZC exhibition copy as checked on 2026-09-23. The installed Noto Serif SC fallback handles characters entered later by a reader.

Atlas 使用 **朱雀仿宋 v0.212** 呈现中文标题，以 **霞鹜文楷 GB v1.522** 呈现中文长文。截至 2026-09-23，网页子集覆盖 Atlas 0.3 源码、文档与 ChefZC 展柜新增文案的全部汉字；后续输入的字符若未包含在子集中，会回退到思源宋体。

- Zhuque Fangsong: https://github.com/TrionesType/zhuque — SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL-Zhuque.txt`.
- LXGW WenKai GB: https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenkaiGB — SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL-WenKai.txt`.

These font licenses apply to the fonts, independently of the Atlas source license. / 字体授权独立于 Atlas 源码授权。
